key_insight: A classifier chain model can recommend likely pathology tests from patient symptoms, improving speed and accuracy before physician consultation.
clinical_relevance: This could help clinicians triage diagnostic workups more efficiently while preserving interpretable reasoning for test selection.
method: Framed test recommendation as a multi-label classification problem.
Compared Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, and Random Forest with Classifier Chain.
Used SHAP to explain which symptoms drove each test recommendation.
evidence_signal: On the SOUTHERN.IML pathology data plus an expert-created dataset, Logistic Regression with Classifier Chain achieved 98.83% accuracy, while a Majority Voting ensemble reached precision 0.93, recall 0.85, and F1-score 0.89.
watch_item: Results are promising, but real-world use would require external validation on diverse patient populations and careful integration into clinical workflows.
